ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: It lasts as long as the convalescence. Rest in bed shortens it by a third, and working while still weak can set it back. A visit from a friend helps the mood in the meantime.

A doctor who lost a patient, or several. It fades with time; a friend's visit or a good talk helps in the meantime. Good medicine and clean hospital beds make the next loss less likely, and the council may be asked to give the doctor a day away.

ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.keep: Good doctoring and good company. A doctor the colony trusts puts patients at ease each time they tend them, and friends who visit the sickbed lift both moods.
